fullDescription: Editorial 'manifesto' startup website: warm cream paper base, near-black ink, a single hot-magenta accent, huge Fraunces serif display headline with italic emphasis, hairline-divided big-number stat rows, a dark ink founder note with a handwritten signature, a 4-up numbered values grid, and a full-bleed magenta CTA band.

structured.summary: An editorial 'manifesto' startup website that reads like the about/manifesto page of a high-taste product studio. Warm cream paper base (#faf6ef) with near-black ink text (#16130f) and a single hot-magenta accent (#d6246e). A huge Fraunces serif display headline ('We design the startup before it exists.') with one italic light-weight magenta word, Inter for UI/body. Sticky blurred nav with a compass-badge wordmark, a manifesto hero, a full-bleed rounded gradient image strip with an italic serif caption, a 'why we exist' editorial 2-column block, a hairline-divided big-number proof/stat list, a dark ink founder-note card with a handwritten italic signature, a 4-up numbered values grid, a full-bleed magenta CTA band with a faint grid texture, and a dark ink footer. Restraint, big type, generous whitespace, one accent color.

style.description: Warm editorial manifesto. Cream paper base, near-black warm ink for type, a single hot-magenta accent used sparingly for emphasis words, eyebrows, stat tags and one CTA. Fraunces variable serif (optical sizing, opsz 40-144) for all display/headings with italic light-weight phrases for emphasis; Inter for nav/body/labels. Big confident display type with tight negative letter-spacing, hairline rules (1px ink at ~14% opacity), generous vertical rhythm, fully-rounded pill buttons, and faint grid/dot textures on the gradient strip and magenta CTA. Mood: high-taste, literary, restrained, confident; never busy, neon-soup, or corporate-template.
style.prompt: Design in a warm editorial 'manifesto' style. Palette: cream paper base #faf6ef, deeper cream #f3ecdf for panels, near-black warm ink #16130f for text, muted ink #5a544a for secondary copy, a single hot-magenta accent #d6246e (deeper #a81554 for hovers). Use exactly one accent color: magenta only for emphasis words, uppercase eyebrows, stat tags, one primary CTA and small dots, never spread across the page. Headings use the Fraunces variable serif (font-variation-settings 'opsz' 40 to 144, weights 300-600, with italic light-weight phrases for emphasis and an italic 'signature' style at opsz 96 for the founder sign-off); nav, body, labels and buttons use Inter (300-600). Display headline uses clamp(2.7rem,8.5vw,8.4rem) with letter-spacing about -0.022em and leading ~0.95. Numbers ('num') use opsz 144 with tighter -0.03em tracking. Rules are 1px ink at 14% opacity; section eyebrows are uppercase 12px with wide 0.28em letter-spacing in magenta. Buttons are fully-rounded pills (ink->magenta hover, or solid magenta->magentadeep). Add faint cream grid-line textures over the gradient image strip and the magenta CTA, and a soft radial magenta glow inside dark ink panels. ::selection is magenta on cream. Keep it restrained, literary, big-type and confident, with lots of whitespace.

layout_and_structure.description: Single-column long-form editorial page centered in a max-w-[1240px] container with px-6 / md:px-10 gutters. Top-down order: sticky blurred header nav; manifesto hero (eyebrow rule row + huge serif headline + lede paragraph + two pill CTAs); a full-bleed rounded gradient image strip with an italic serif caption and a glass sparkle badge; a 'why we exist' 12-col editorial block (4-col heading / 7-col body + a 2-up feature pair); a hairline-divided proof list of 4 big-number stat rows (number / description / magenta tag) with hover-row left-nudge; a dark ink founder-note card (3-col attribution with avatar / 8-col pull-quote + signature); a 4-up (md:2-col) numbered values grid with top-border cells; a full-bleed magenta CTA band with grid texture and radial glow; and a dark ink footer (5-col brand statement + three link columns + bottom bar). Responsive: all 12-col grids collapse to single column under md, nav links hide under md (CTA pill stays), the stat rows stack number-over-text, and clamp() display type scales down cleanly.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (z-50) with a translucent cream background (bg-cream/85) + backdrop blur and a thin ink/10 bottom border. Inside a max-w-[1240px] row, height 68px: left = a 28px circular ink badge holding a cream compass icon (ph:compass-fill) next to the 'Northbound' wordmark in Fraunces (opsz 40, semibold, tight tracking); center = four Inter 14px muted-ink text links (Why we exist, The work, Founder note, Values) that darken to ink on hover, hidden below md; right = a small ink pill CTA 'Start a build' (13.5px) that turns magenta on hover over 300ms.

A tall hero in the max-w-[1240px] container (pt-20 md:pt-32). First an eyebrow row: a magenta uppercase 'Manifesto' label, a flex-1 1px ink/14% rule, and a muted 'Est. 2024' label on the right. Then a huge Fraunces display headline at clamp(2.7rem,8.5vw,8.4rem), weight 500, leading 0.95, max-width 14ch, reading 'We design the [startup] before it exists.' where 'startup' is italic, light-weight and magenta. Below, a max-w-[46ch] light muted-ink lede (17-19px) explaining the studio turns a one-line idea into a website, brand and working interface in days. Then a CTA row: a solid magenta pill 'Generate your first page' with an up-right arrow icon (hover magentadeep), and a ghost link 'Read the thinking' with a 36px circular outlined down-arrow icon button.

Inside the container, a rounded-[20px] band (h-260px md:h-440px) standing in for a hero image. Its fill is layered: two radial gradients (magenta glow top-left, ink glow bottom-right) over a 118deg linear gradient from deeper cream #f3ecdf through pink #f0c7d9 and magenta #d6246e to ink #16130f. Overlay a faint cream grid texture (two perpendicular 1px cream/60 lines on a 54px cell at ~16% opacity). At the bottom, a Fraunces italic cream caption (opsz 72, clamp(1.3rem,3.2vw,2.6rem), max 18ch) reading 'An idea, rendered. Before the doubt sets in.', with a 56px circular glass sparkle badge (cream/15 bg, backdrop blur, cream/30 border, ph:sparkle-fill) on the right (hidden on mobile).

An editorial 12-col grid section (id=exist). Left 4 cols: a magenta uppercase 'Why we exist' eyebrow and a Fraunces 500 multi-line heading (opsz 96, clamp(2.1rem,4.6vw,3.6rem), letter-spacing -0.02em) 'The gap between [vision] and the first pixel.' with 'vision' italic light. Right 7 cols (col-start-6): a large light 18-21px ink lead paragraph, a smaller muted follow-up paragraph, then a 2-up (sm:2-col) feature pair, each feature = a magenta Phosphor icon (ph:lightning-fill, ph:stack-fill) + a Fraunces semibold 18px label ('Idea to interface', 'Coherent by default') over a small muted description line.

A proof section (id=proof) framed top and bottom by 1px ink/14% rules, with rows separated by ink/12% dividers. Four rows, each a 12-col baseline-aligned grid: col-span-4 = a huge Fraunces 500 'num' number (opsz 144, clamp(2.6rem,6vw,4.8rem), leading none) like 12,400+, 9 min, 2,100, and an infinity glyph; col-span-5 = a muted 15-16px description; col-span-3 right-aligned = a magenta uppercase wide-tracked tag (Generated, Idea to live, Launched, Canvas). Each row is a 'hover-row' that nudges its content left by 14px on hover over 0.35s. Rows stack to single column under md.

A dark ink rounded-[24px] card (id=founder, bg #16130f, text cream) with generous padding and a soft magenta radial glow blob bleeding off the top-right corner. Inside, a 12-col grid: left 3 cols = a magenta uppercase 'A note from the founder' eyebrow, then an attribution row of a 48px magenta circular avatar with a Fraunces 'M' monogram, the name 'Mara Lindqvist' (Fraunces semibold cream) and a cream/55 role line. Right 8 cols (col-start-5) = a large Fraunces light pull-quote (opsz 96, clamp(1.5rem,3vw,2.4rem), leading 1.25) with one italic magenta phrase, two cream/70 light follow-up paragraphs (max 58ch), then a sign-off row: a handwritten italic Fraunces 'signature' (magenta, opsz 96, clamp(2rem,4vw,3.1rem)) reading 'Mara L.' over an uppercase cream/45 role caption, with a large faint cream compass icon on the right.

A values section (id=values). Header row: a Fraunces 500 heading (opsz 144, clamp(2.1rem,5vw,4rem)) 'What we hold [true]' with 'true' italic light magenta, and a right-aligned muted 14px supporting line (max 34ch). Below, a 2-col (md) x 2-row grid of four value cells, each cell separated by a top border (ink/15) with pt-7 spacing: a baseline row of a magenta Fraunces 'num' serial (01-04) beside a Fraunces semibold title (opsz 72, clamp(1.4rem,2.4vw,1.9rem)) like 'Taste is a feature, not a finish', then a muted 15.5px body line indented under the title (md:pl-9).

prompts.partPt: Magenta Chamada Final para Ação band
prompts.prompt: A full-bleed rounded-[28px] magenta band (id=join, bg #d6246e, text cream) with two textures: a faint cream grid (1px cream/90 lines on a 60px cell at 12% opacity) and a large soft ink radial glow blob bleeding off the bottom-left. Content: a cream/75 uppercase 'Join us north' eyebrow, a huge Fraunces 500 headline (opsz 144, clamp(2.4rem,6vw,5.6rem), leading 0.98) 'Bring the idea. [We will design the rest.]' with the second line italic light. Then a CTA row: a solid cream pill 'Start a build, free' (ink text, inverts to ink bg + cream text on hover) with an up-right arrow, and an outlined cream/40 ghost pill 'Talk to the studio'.

A dark ink footer (bg #16130f, text cream). max-w-[1240px] 12-col grid: col-span-5 brand block = a magenta compass badge + 'Northbound' Fraunces wordmark over a Fraunces italic cream/65 statement (opsz 72, max 20ch) 'The studio that designs startups before they exist.'; then three link columns (Studio, Build, Follow) each with an uppercase wide-tracked cream/40 heading and cream/75 links that turn magenta on hover, the Follow column links carrying small Phosphor social icons (ph:x-logo, ph:github-logo, ph:dribbble-logo). A top-bordered (cream/12) bottom bar splits a cream/45 copyright from Privacy / Terms links and a 'Heading north' chip with a tiny magenta dot.

special_ui_components.prompt: Single-accent editorial system: hot magenta #d6246e used only for emphasis words, uppercase eyebrows, stat tags, one primary CTA and small dots, against cream + ink
Fraunces variable serif used expressively: opsz 40 wordmark, opsz 72/96 sub-display, opsz 144 hero/values, italic light-weight emphasis phrases, and an italic 'signature' founder sign-off
Eyebrow rule row: uppercase magenta label + flex-1 1px ink/14% hairline + a muted right-side label (used in the hero)
Hover-row stat list: hairline-divided big-number rows that slide their content left ~14px on hover (transition 0.35s)
Full-bleed gradient 'image' strip: layered radial + 118deg linear gradient (cream -> pink -> magenta -> ink) under a faint cream grid texture, with an italic serif caption and a glass sparkle badge
Dark ink panels (founder card + footer + as a CTA inverse) with soft magenta/ink radial glow blobs bleeding off the corners
Faint grid textures: perpendicular 1px cream lines on 54px / 60px cells layered over the gradient strip and the magenta CTA band
Phosphor (Iconify ph:*) icons: compass-fill, arrow-up-right-bold, arrow-down, sparkle-fill, lightning-fill, stack-fill, and social logos
Fully-rounded pill buttons in four variants: solid ink (->magenta), solid magenta (->magentadeep), solid cream-on-dark (inverts on hover), and outlined ghost
::selection styled magenta-on-cream; html scroll-behavior smooth with scroll-mt anchored sections

structured.special_notes: Fonts loaded from Google Fonts: Fraunces (ital, opsz 9..144, weights 300..900, serif display with optical sizing via font-variation-settings) and Inter (300/400/500/600, sans UI/body). Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme palette: cream #faf6ef, creamdeep #f3ecdf, ink #16130f, inkmute #5a544a, magenta #d6246e, magentadeep #a81554, with serif=Fraunces and sans=Inter font families. No photographs are used: the only 'image' is the gradient + grid texture strip, so the design is fully self-contained. Keep strictly to one accent color (magenta); the mood must stay warm, editorial, literary and restrained, never neon-soup, dark-mode-default, or corporate-template. Container is max-w-[1240px]; all 12-col grids collapse to single column under the md breakpoint and the display type scales via clamp().
